newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Daimler Benz Brazil unit to post 96 operating loss.
newsitem.headline: Daimler Benz Brazil unit to post 96 operating loss.

text.p: Daimler Benz AG 's Brazil unit Mercedes Benz will post operating loss in 1996, said Mercedes Benz president Ben Van Schaik.
"We will have operating losses of some tens of millions dollars in 1996," he said, noting that an exact figure would be released only in February.
But he said that the company would break even its results in 1997, adding that gross sales would rise by 10 percent next year, up from the $2.5 billion in 1996.
Schaik said 1996 results were affected by a 28 percent overall drop in the Brazilian truck and bus sales and restructuring costs.
Mercedes Benz expects to produce 34,000 vehicles, including buses and trucks, next year, he added.
Mercedes Benz is Brazil's largest truck maker and the Brazilian operations account for 20 percent of the company's world sales.
